title: Warning for 1 led work order in Estimate and no lines
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, who holds nothing except the work named below.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Estimate, led by staff member A, with no line that staff member A is on, so the warning has one led work order to count.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician off.
  3. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Staff Member window opens with Technician on.

Step 2:

  • The Technician toggle is off.

Step 3:

  • The warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows, with a Cancel button and a Save button.
  • Its text reads "[staff member A's first and last name] leads 1 open work order. They'll stay on it, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."

In the warning texts, [staff member A's first and last name] stands for staff member A's name exactly as it was last saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off)

  • S2-R3, 1 work order, no lines: “1 work order, no lines: "[Name] leads 1 open work order. They'll stay on it, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”
  • S2-R2: “When at least one work order or line is counted, a warning window titled "Turn Off Technician" shows. The text names the staff member as last saved (a new name typed in the same save is not used) and what they hold, for example: "Jordan Lee leads 8 open work orders and is on 50 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”
  • S2-R1: “When the user saves, before anything else, the system counts the staff member's open work across every location of the organization: the work orders they lead and the lines they are on, whether they have labor on the line, were added to it with Add Technician, or are the line's own technician, where the work order is a service work order in Estimate, Approved, In Progress or Ready for Review and the line is not declined. Each work order and each line is counted once. A line on a work order the person also leads still counts, so that job shows as one work order they lead and one line they are on. A person added to a line through a schedule shift is on the line, the same as one added with Add Technician.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Saving a staff member that turns Technician off while they hold open work (S2-R2) | Title "Turn Off Technician"; text "[Name] leads [n] open work orders and is on [n] labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new." (other forms per S2-R3) | Warning window, Cancel or Save”
  • Terminology: “Open work → in the turn-off warning, a service work order in Estimate, Approved, In Progress or Ready for Review that the person leads, or a line of such a work order that is not declined and that they are on (with labor on it, added with Add Technician or through a schedule shift, or as the line's own technician). On release day, only Approved, In Progress and Ready for Review count (Story 6).”
  • Key Decisions: “Turning Technician off warns and then allows; it never unassigns.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "4 Turn Technician off with open work", pictures "Turn Off Technician warning" (This build) and "Switched off" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p4-02-after-turn-off-technician-warning.png
  • tt-p4-01-after-switched-off.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save shows this first, only when the person still leads an open work order or is on a line of one (with labor, added with Add Technician, or as the line's technician), at any location. Otherwise Save goes straight on.”
  • “Text, verbatim with this demo's counts: "Emily Madden leads 15 open work orders and is on 141 labor lines. They'll stay on them, but won't be offered as a technician on anything new."”
  • “Cancel, the X or Escape leave the staff member unsaved. Save continues the save. Nothing is unassigned either way.”
  • “Technician switched off, not saved yet. Switching Time Clock off has the same effect, because it turns Technician off.”

The design draws the plural form only ("Emily Madden leads 15 open work orders and is on 141 labor lines"); the single-count forms are not drawn (register TT-N04). The text comes from S2-R3.
